status: measurement defined; cohort eligibility unresolved; no new scores read
biological_claim: Partial external-signature recruitment in a comparable injury state; no lineage or functional-repair claim
starting_population: Adult mouse injury epithelium with independently supported transitional and activated-AT2 compartments
unit: Independent mouse; pooled animals are not decomposed into mice
exposure: Independent injury study; compatible day 2 through day 21 schedule required for an unchanged replication
numerator: Sum of exact 500-UMI expected gene detections, averaged over assayed module genes and eligible cells
denominator: Assayed module genes including observed zeros; eligible cells within each state; equal weight per eligible mouse
primary_estimand: Equal-mouse mean paired difference, conditional on eligible independent replication-cohort mice and the sampled day 2-21 schedule

inherited_instrument.authorization: Owner requested proceeding with the review revisions and biological rationale; commit before counts.
inherited_instrument.measurement: Expected detection after 500-UMI sampling without replacement; equal-mouse paired difference in percentage points
inherited_instrument.estimand: Equal-mouse mean paired difference, conditional on eligible mice and the sampled day 2-21 schedule
inherited_instrument.primary_test: two-sided one-sample t test of paired differences, alpha 0.05, 95% t interval
inherited_instrument.secondary_family: Holm across three tests; ineligible tests enter correction as p=1
descriptive: original shared contract modules and Strunz-filtered 51-gene module
Guo identity axes and six Hallmark axes
inherited_instrument.interpretation: External-source signature recruitment; no untouched-cohort, lineage, mechanism or successful-repair claim
inherited_instrument.on_primary_failure: Stop, do not lower depth/cell floors or switch reference

module_selection: Frozen external source definitions; no candidate-cohort marker filtering
state_mapping: Defined from independent source labels/evidence before module scoring
missingness: Absent genes are excluded from score denominator and count against coverage; observed zeros retained. Missing state or unit identity fails paired eligibility, never imputed.

decision.positive: 95% interval wholly above zero supports recruitment under the specified sampling population
decision.contradictory: 95% interval wholly below zero contradicts directional transfer in this context
decision.inconclusive: Interval crosses zero; no equivalence or absence claim
decision.ineligible: Stop without scoring or reference/floor retuning

precision: Historical n>=3 is eligibility only. Before scoring, report interval half-width sensitivity to independent-unit count and plausible between-unit SD, without using the original positive mean as the sole planning assumption.
functional_endpoint: Not available in this test; a later study must select an independent lineage/function endpoint
